scope: Offline sensitivity experiment only; no production activation, fallback, threshold fitting, dimension migration, or source database writes.

model.family: local Ollama nomic-embed-text tag; underlying release not separately resolved
model.normalization: L2 unit normalization after inference; nearest-neighbor metric is L2 over normalized vectors.

context.prompt_length_measure: Ollama API prompt_eval_count from one-input-per-request responses; record character and UTF-8 byte lengths as well.
context.overlength_handling: Record an input rejected specifically for context length, omit only that input from the vector index, and continue; do not retry with truncation. Record prompt_eval_count as unavailable for rejected inputs. Abort on any other error.

ollama.request_pattern: One POST /api/embed request per input, sequentially; keep_alive=10m.

corpus.selection: All non-empty rows matching the current profile allowlist, ordered by chunk id; this is the existing 4,732-chunk profile slice, not a sample of the full 270,498-chunk database.
corpus.source_mode: SQLite URI mode=ro; vectors are held in a transient in-memory sqlite-vec index; source database is never modified.

policy_variants.expansion: double K until five policy-eligible candidates or min(index rows, 4096)

evaluation.primary: covered-group exact normalized expected-title hit at rank 1 and ranks 1-5 (10 exploratory queries)
evaluation.secondary: title concentration, distinct titles, candidate K, per-query results, input lengths and embedding hashes

interpretation_limits: Same 48 hand-authored exploratory probes and same 4,732-row profile slice; not blind independent gold.
Only 10 queries have expected titles and are marked covered.
This isolates retrieval cap sensitivity for one frozen embedding model; it does not establish semantic answer quality or production suitability.
Embedding pass is recomputed once; policy variants reuse the same in-memory vectors.
No production activation, threshold fitting, fallback, vector migration, or source database write.
revision_note: Executor now records expected context-limit rejections without truncation and continues; first attempt stopped before producing results at the first such input.

post_run_sanitization.reason: Independent exact-tip review found raw local document/source identifiers and an absolute input path.
